description: How to prompt Kling 4 (Kling 4.0, kling_v4) for cinematic AI video that does not look like AI slop: let a strong image model compose every shot, then give Kling 4 two to four key frames and a short director's prompt. Covers reference-to-video inputs (@Image, @Element, @Video, @Voice), multi-shot prompts with seconds, 30-second takes, dialogue in quotes, "no slow motion", lens and film-look lines, prompts that fail and their rewrites, elements that need two photos, the failure fixes (slow motion by default, six fingers, AI-smooth framing, face drift in close-ups) and the exact varg call with the reference route pinned. Use when someone asks how to prompt Kling 4, why Kling 4 looks worse than Seedance 2.5, how to use Kling 4 reference-to-video, elements, multi_prompt or keyframes, or wants a Kling 4 prompt written. For a whole short film use kling-4-keyframe-film; for a 30-second action montage use kling-4-action-montage.
